initiatives.name: Show-up engine
initiatives.concept: Turn every registration into a held seat: instant auto-confirm, no general waitlist, a switch/transfer cancel flow and a WhatsApp cadence that reconfirms at T-8 but never releases a general-entry pass.
initiatives.why_it_works: T-8 reconfirm gap and opt-out rate
initiatives.primary_kpi: T-8 YES-rate gap (treated vs holdout) on Fri 5 Mar; before that, opt-out and plan-completion from Gate 1 and the cancel-flow save rate at Gate 3.
initiatives.scale_rule: T-8 gap >= 5pp and opt-out <= 3%: add a day-2 nudge to day-1 no-shows and show the plan prompt to every treated registrant.
initiatives.change_rule: Gap < 2pp, plan completion < 30%, opt-out 3-8% or cancel save < 10%: switch to the better wording, make the plan prompt one tap, drop T-30, make 'transfer to your squad' the default.
initiatives.stop_rule: Opt-out > 8% on any send or Meta quality rating 'low' for 3 days: keep only the pass, T-1 and morning-of (two reminders beat one [SHOW-10]).

initiatives.name: College club-charter grid
initiatives.concept: Scale 2025's best channel to 40 partner colleges (30 metro engineering, 10 OU-area degree and women's), each chartering 2-3 clubs that compete in a Club Cup ranked on verified check-ins.
initiatives.why_it_works: Active partners per week and registrations per partner-week
initiatives.primary_kpi: Partner-code registrations per active partner-week, and the matched-pair sign test at Gate 1.
initiatives.scale_rule: >= 4.5 registrations per partner-week and Wave A ahead in >= 9 of 12 pairs at Gate 2: the reserve funds Wave C (8 standbys) and a second co-hosted event at the top 20 partners.
initiatives.change_rule: Below 3.3 per partner-week (85% of plan) for 2 weeks: swap the activation (club co-hosted mini-event instead of posters; switch IEEE charter to a dance or music club) and move volunteer hours to top-quartile partners. (Hold band: 3.3-4.5.)
initiatives.stop_rule: A partner with < 1 registration a week for 2 consecutive active weeks is dropped and its campus handed to ambassadors. Grid projected CPV (accrual) > Rs 275 for 2 weeks freezes new MoUs. A bus with < 25 seats at T-10 is cancelled.

initiatives.name: Verified-check-in peer loop
initiatives.concept: Make attendance a group decision: a Squad Pass at registration, a 60-ambassador league in non-partner colleges and a day-1 friend link, all rewarded only on verified check-ins.
initiatives.why_it_works: Share rate x invites x invite conversion (k)
initiatives.primary_kpi: 48-hour share rate in the squad A/B; ambassador activation at day 14.
initiatives.scale_rule: Share-rate gap >= 5pp at p < 0.1 at Gate 2: squad-first becomes the default; fast-lane entry for squads fully reconfirmed by T-1.
initiatives.change_rule: k 0.12-0.18 (below 90% of the base plan) or share rate 10-20%: move the share prompt into the plan-making 'who with' step, cut the minimum squad to 3, switch to zero-cash front-zone access. (Hold: k 0.18 or more.)
initiatives.stop_rule: k < 0.12 after one change cycle (Gate 3): revert to a plain referral link and move unspent squad rewards (about Rs 15K) to the reserve. An ambassador with > 10% duplicates is disqualified; one inactive at day 14 is replaced.

initiatives.name: Paid rebuilt as Click-to-WhatsApp
initiatives.concept: Cut paid and creators from Rs 1,52,000 to Rs 55,000 and rebuild the rest as geo-tested Click-to-WhatsApp Reels plus 4 Telugu nano creators, every lead landing in the engine.
initiatives.why_it_works: Cost per registration and the show quality of paid registrants
initiatives.primary_kpi: Weekly cost per registration by ad set and creator, with the show score of the registrants it buys.
initiatives.scale_rule: CTWA <= Rs 73 per registration with show score >= 55% at Gate 2: full Rs 28K flight and eligibility for the reserve. (Hold band: Rs 74-115, which contains the base Rs 110.)
initiatives.change_rule: CTWA Rs 116-137 per registration, or CTR down > 30% week on week: rotate creative within 72 h, shift to retargeting engagers, swap the weakest creator. Creators above Rs 137: no second round (Rs 7,500 to the reserve); reuse their content as CTWA creative.
initiatives.stop_rule: CTWA > Rs 137 per registration (2025 average) for 2 consecutive weeks: pause and return the rest to the reserve. A creator > Rs 200 per registration gets no further posts.

initiatives.name: Compete-to-attend
initiatives.concept: Three sponsor-funded team tracks (10-12 hour daytime AI hackathon, BGMI cup, cultural crew battles) where every team member gets a pass; run only if a prize sponsor signs.
initiatives.why_it_works: Sponsor signing date and slot fill
initiatives.primary_kpi: Sponsor signature on 12 Jan, then slot fill by track on 14 Feb.
initiatives.scale_rule: >= 90% of slots filled by Sun 14 Feb: open 20% more slots and add supporter passes, within the 4,500 pass cap.
initiatives.change_rule: One track < 30% while others fill: move promotion to faster tracks, push IEEE and E-cell circulars, add a college-vs-college bracket.
initiatives.stop_rule: No sponsor by Tue 12 Jan: no competitions; Rs 15K to the reserve. All tracks < 30% on Sun 14 Feb: stop and move the unspent balance to the reserve.
